_doc: How freely an agent may act, keyed by its SFIA level of responsibility. read = tools marked read-only; write = changes that can be undone; destructive = deletes, sends to outside parties, deploys, payments. auto = act without asking; approve = ask a human first; never = do not attempt.
_note: Destructive actions always need a human, whatever the level. Raise an individual agent's level in agentLevels.
